display.name: Candidate Reviewer
display.description: Reads resumes and scores each candidate against the job posting.

input.title: Resume
input.description: A PDF, Word file or photo.

groups.title: Add candidate
groups.description: A resume: PDF, Word file or photo.

groups.title: AI review
groups.description: Reads the resume and scores it.

pipeline.title: Resume received
pipeline.description: A PDF, Word file or photo arrives.

pipeline.title: Resume read
pipeline.description: AI reads experience, education, certifications and links.

pipeline.title: Resume checked
pipeline.description: Checks it is a resume and can be read.

pipeline.title: Candidate scored
pipeline.description: Scored against the posting, with reasons.

pipeline.title: Candidate saved
pipeline.description: Added to the posting's list, highest score first.

file.title: Job description
file.description: A PDF, Word file or photo.

pipeline.title: Job description received
pipeline.description: A PDF, Word file or photo arrives.

department.description: The department or team, as printed.

location.description: Where the role is based, as printed, remote or hybrid included.

employmentType.description: Full-time, part-time, contract, temporary or internship, as printed.

summary.description: What the role is, in one or two sentences of at most 200 characters, in the description's own terms.

mustHaves.description: Each requirement the description says a candidate must have, one short line each, in its words.

niceToHaves.description: Each requirement it calls preferred, desirable, a plus or nice to have, one short line each.

responsibilities.description: Each duty of the role, one short line each.

minimumYears.description: The fewest years of experience the description asks for; null when no number of years is printed.

education.description: The education it asks for, as printed.

certifications.description: Each licence or certification it names.

skills.description: Each tool, system or skill it names.

pay.description: The salary, rate or range as printed, with its currency and period.

uncertainFields.description: Each field printed but blurred, cut off or only partly legible.

outputSchema.description: The job's reading: its job description read once, only from what is printed. An empty string for a text, an empty list for a list and null for a number that is not printed or cannot be read.
A candidate's run: the job's reading it was scored against, the resume's reading, the years of experience worked out from its dates, and the score with its reasons.

niceToHaves.description: Each requirement it calls preferred, desirable, a plus or nice to have, one short line each.

responsibilities.description: Each duty of the role, one short line each.

minimumYears.description: The fewest years of experience the description asks for; null when no number of years is printed.

education.description: The education it asks for, as printed.

certifications.description: Each licence or certification it names.

skills.description: Each tool, system or skill it names.

pay.description: The salary, rate or range as printed, with its currency and period.

anyOf.description: The job's reading: its job description read once, only from what is printed. An empty string for a text, an empty list for a list and null for a number that is not printed or cannot be read.

email.description: The candidate's email address, as printed.

phone.description: The candidate's phone number, as printed.

location.description: Where the candidate is, as printed.

label.description: What it is, as printed or as its site names it, such as LinkedIn or Portfolio.

links.description: Each web address printed: a profile, a portfolio, a site.

summary.description: The resume's own summary or profile, in at most 200 characters; empty when it has none.

start.description: When the role began: YYYY-MM when the month and year are printed, YYYY when only the year is; empty when not printed.

end.description: When the role ended, written as start is; empty when it is current or not printed.

current.description: True when the role is printed as present, current or now.

highlights.description: Each thing done in the role, one short line each, as printed.

experience.description: Each role, most recent first, as printed.

degree.description: The degree or qualification, as printed.

school.description: The school, college or university, as printed.

year.description: The year it was completed or is expected, as printed.

description.description: What it is, in at most 200 characters.

url.description: Its web address, as printed; empty when none is.

name.description: The certification or licence, as printed.

year.description: The year it was earned, as printed.

certifications.description: Each certification or licence, as printed.

skills.description: Each skill, tool or system, as printed.

languages.description: Each language the candidate speaks, as printed, with its level when printed.

uncertainFields.description: Each field printed but blurred, cut off or only partly legible.

resume.description: The candidate's resume, read only from what is printed.

yearsOfExperience.description: Years of experience from the resume's dated roles, overlaps counted once; null when none is dated.

score.description: How well the candidate fits the posting, from 0 to 100.

summary.description: Why, in one sentence of at most 200 characters, naming the reasons.

requirement.description: The requirement, copied as the posting words it.

kind.description: must_have for one of the posting's mustHaves, nice_to_have for one of its niceToHaves.

evidence.description: What in the resume meets it, in at most 200 characters.

matches.description: Each of the posting's must-haves and nice-to-haves the resume meets.

requirement.description: The requirement, copied as the posting words it.

kind.description: must_have for one of the posting's mustHaves, nice_to_have for one of its niceToHaves.

gaps.description: Each of the posting's must-haves and nice-to-haves the resume does not show.

experienceFit.description: How the candidate's experience compares with what the posting asks, in one short line; empty when it asks nothing of it.

educationFit.description: How the candidate's education compares with what the posting asks, in one short line; empty when it asks nothing of it.

certificationsFit.description: How the candidate's certifications compare with what the posting asks, in one short line; empty when it asks nothing of them.

flags.description: Each thing a person should check, one short line each; empty when there is none.

scoring.description: The candidate scored against the job's reading, with the reasons.
